patch_description: The current program regressed to 0.19 (from 0.81 for the hill-climb variant). Two targeted fixes, following the recommendation: (1) add a hull-expansion move inside the proven exact-ratio `_polish` loop — each round, try scaling all points about their centroid by 1.01× and accept only if the true score (min_area/hull_area) improves, which helps escape configurations where interior points are crowded and hull growth is score-beneficial; (2) cut the expensive softmin gradient iterations roughly in half (2500→1200 and step decay adjusted) since the gradient stage mostly serves as initialization for the exact polish, reducing eval time toward the 5.7s of the best variant while leaving polish quality intact. The polish remains fully deterministic (seeded RNG) and operates on the exact objective, so improvements are guaranteed real score gains.
